mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate over three months signals weakening consumer demand and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures over three months signals weakening consumer demand and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining GDP (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment over three months signals strengthening labor market conditions and higher corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising PAYEMS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures over three months signals strengthening consumer demand and higher corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising GDP (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index over three months signals strengthening manufacturing activity and higher corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts over three months signals weakening residential construction activity and lower corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).
